text: Driver turnover moves with dispatch tenure more than with pay. The two terminals that kept dispatchers held turnover under 35%.
Regional pricing rollouts hold only when the sales comp plan changes first. Ortega changed comp in March; price held in Q2.
Whitfield reports integration slippage as a vendor problem. Check whether the internal data owner is staffed before accepting that.
Hangar projects at Corvus have never hit the first date given. Three for three. Plan the board conversation on the second date.
The warehouse pilot equipment is in, but the integration with the warehouse system is not on the schedule. The September throughput read may come off a manual count.
